title: fix: display model prices in their billing units
author: ElliotEtag
pr_body_excerpt:
- Fix Qwen Image 2.1 showing zero per generation: it now shows 0.02 Pollen per billable megapixel (0.0367 for edits, via the existing operation control). FLUX.2 rates are labelled per megapixel too.
- Add optional `pricing_units` to the public `/models` response. Registry entries declare the billed unit next to their rates when the pricing field name doesn't describe it. Displayed rate = `pricing[field] × quantity` (quantity defaults to 1), e.g. Qwen `0.00000002 × 1,000,000 = 0.02` per megapixel. Other clients can now show these prices correctly, and the dashboard's per-model unit table is gone.
- Mark Lyria 3 Clip as flat-rate: it shows 0.04 per clip instead of 0.6/sec, and gen's per-request estimate is corrected to 0.04.
- Restore missing image, video, text, cache and audio rate rows. Show Gemini TTS and Transcribe per token, and character- or byte-billed speech in its real unit. Update the pricing legend to match.
- Keep small rates from rounding to zero, fix the combined cache-write scale, and stop paid variants or requests over 1 Pollen from looking free or cheaper. Provider rates and billed amounts are unchanged.

Deploy order: Enter and gen deploy independently. Deploy gen first, confirm `/models` returns `pricing_units`, then deploy Enter. Otherwise Qwen and FLUX show the wrong unit until gen ships.

Validation: Enter pricing tests, price snapshot and typecheck pass. gen `/models`, OpenAPI, docs and Lyria billing tests and typecheck pass. Biome is clean. The UI was checked locally against a catalog built from this branch's registry.

gist.headline: Prices get their units back
gist.blurb: A price without its billing unit is a fairly adventurous number. Model listings get clearer labels for megapixels, clips, tokens, characters, and bytes.
gist.summary: The public /models response gains optional pricing_units so clients can display billed quantities correctly; the model catalog also fixes Qwen Image 2.1, FLUX.2, and Lyria 3 Clip labels and restores missing rate rows without changing provider rates or billed amounts.
gist.impact: Qwen Image 2.1 displays 0.02 Pollen per billable megapixel (0.0367 for edits), while Lyria 3 Clip displays and estimates 0.04 per clip instead of 0.6 per second; small rates and other billing units remain legible.
